heading.en: Birth, schooling and early business career

body.zh-Hant: 奧古斯托·萊吉亞1863年2月19日生於蘭巴耶克，曾在瓦爾帕萊索的一所英國學校學習會計。他在商界發展，1896年創辦英國糖業公司，1900年又創辦南美保險公司。
body.en: Augusto Bernardino Leguía was born in Lambayeque on 19 February 1863 and studied accounting in a British school in Valparaíso. He made his way in business, founding the British Sugar Company in 1896 and the South America Insurance Company in 1900.

heading.zh-Hant: 財政部長與第一任總統任期

body.zh-Hant: 萊吉亞在政壇迅速崛起，先在曼努埃爾·坎達莫與何塞·帕爾多兩位總統任內擔任財政部長。他以文官黨正式支持的總統候選人身分，於1908年當選總統。第一任期內他面對1909年的一次政變企圖，1908至1910年間還須應付與鄰國的國際危機。
body.en: Leguía rose meteorically in politics, first serving as finance minister under Presidents Manuel Candamo and José Pardo. As a presidential candidate with the official blessing of the Civilista Party, he was elected president in 1908. In his first term he faced an attempted coup in 1909, and from 1908 to 1910 he also had to deal with international crises with neighbouring states.

first serving as finance minister under Presidents Manuel Candamo and José Pardo

Leguía was elected president in 1908
In an attempted coup in 1909
From 1908 to 1910 Leguía also had to face international crises

body.zh-Hant: 1913年之後萊吉亞旅居國外，主要住在倫敦，1918年帶著強大的民意支持回國。他贏得1919年總統選舉，隨後取得軍方支持發動政變，以強化自己的總統權力。
body.en: After 1913 Leguía lived abroad, mainly in London, and in 1918 he returned to Peru with strong popular support. He won the presidential elections of 1919 and then rallied military support for a coup to reinforce his presidential powers.

citations.quote: After 1913 Leguía lived abroad, mainly in London

he rallied military support for a coup to reinforce his presidential powers

body.zh-Hant: 萊吉亞推行「新祖國」（Patria Nueva），經操縱的選舉於1924年與1929年連任，並放逐或監禁許多政敵。第二任期內他藉外國貸款擴大國家角色，在利馬與各省推動公共工程，也解決了大部分舊有邊界爭端，1929年解決與智利的邊界衝突。1930年，他的獨裁統治在世界經濟危機中引發政變，他被路易斯·桑切斯·塞羅上校領導的軍事政變推翻，1932年2月7日死於卡亞俄獄中。
body.en: His efforts to establish a New Fatherland (Patria Nueva) resulted in rigged re-elections in 1924 and 1929, and he exiled or imprisoned many political adversaries. In his second term he enhanced the role of the state with foreign loans, pursued public works in Lima and the provinces, and settled most of the old boundary disputes, resolving the border conflict with Chile in 1929. In 1930 his dictatorial rule, together with the world economic crisis, brought a coup: he was ousted by a military coup led by Colonel Luis Sánchez Cerro, and he died in prison in Callao on 7 February 1932.

heading.en: Life dates and overview of his rule

body.zh-Hant: 弗朗西斯科·貝特朗1866年10月9日生，1926年7月15日去世。《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科全書》稱他在1911至1919年間三度擔任宏都拉斯總統，靠和解與控制並行的政策，使宏都拉斯向來不穩的政局恢復秩序。德國國家圖書館權威檔也記他曾於1911–1912、1913–1915與1916–1919年任總統。
body.en: Francisco Bertrand was born on 9 October 1866 and died on 15 July 1926. The Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture says he served as president of Honduras three times between 1911 and 1919 and, through a policy of reconciliation and control, imposed order on the country's traditionally unstable political system. The German National Library authority record likewise lists presidencies in 1911-1912, 1913-1915 and 1916-1919.

citations.quote: served as president of Honduras three times between 1911 and 1919
Through a policy of reconciliation and control
he imposed order on Honduras's traditionally unstable political system
1911-1912, 1913-1915 und 1916-1919 Präsident von Honduras

heading.en: The 1911 Tacoma peace conference and provisional presidency

body.zh-Hant: 1911年2月21日，美方斡旋的和平會議在宏都拉斯普埃爾托科爾特斯的美艦「塔科馬號」上開幕，美國特使湯瑪斯·道森主持；3月3日的會議上，道森表示依他所見，貝特朗是最合適的人選。依《塔科馬協定》，達維拉政府與博尼利亞領導的叛軍同意停戰，貝特朗被任命為臨時總統，任期1911年3月28日至1912年1月31日，並主持博尼利亞無對手勝出的選舉。
body.en: On 21 February 1911 the peace conference mediated by the United States opened aboard the American war vessel Tacoma at Puerto Cortés, Honduras, with the U.S. special commissioner Thomas C. Dawson presiding. At the session of 3 March 1911 Dawson said he believed Dr. Francisco Bertrand was the best candidate. Under the Tacoma Pact the Dávila government and the rebels led by Manuel Bonilla agreed to end hostilities; Bertrand was appointed provisional president, serving from 28 March 1911 to 31 January 1912, and oversaw elections that Bonilla won without opposition.

heading.zh-Hant: 政府司法部長、副總統與1913至1919年的執政
heading.en: Secretary of government, vice president and rule 1913-1919

body.zh-Hant: 在博尼利亞的繼任政府中，貝特朗任政府司法部長，後來任副總統。1913年3月21日美國公使電報報告博尼利亞總統去世、副總統貝特朗已接任；3月24日他以宏都拉斯總統名義致電美國總統答謝弔唁。百科全書稱他1913年3月20日至1915年7月28日為代理總統，並在任期屆滿前辭職以競選第三任；第三任期1916年2月1日至1919年9月9日，政局相對穩定。他試圖指定繼任者，引發叛亂，1919年9月9日辭職離國。
body.en: In Bonilla's government Bertrand became secretary of government and justice and later vice president. A telegram from the American Minister dated 21 March 1913 reported President Bonilla's death and that Vice President Bertrand had assumed the presidency; on 24 March he telegraphed the U.S. President as President of Honduras to thank him for condolences. The encyclopedia gives his interim presidency as 20 March 1913 to 28 July 1915, after which he resigned to campaign for a third term; the third term, 1 February 1916 to 9 September 1919, was relatively stable. His attempt to impose a successor led to a rebellion, and on 9 September 1919 he resigned and left the country.

heading.zh-Hant: 烏拉圭紅黨領袖與1931年就任

body.zh-Hant: 加夫列爾·特拉是烏拉圭紅黨（Colorado）政治領袖，名義上自視為巴特耶主義者，即何塞·巴特耶·奧多涅斯的追隨者；美國國會圖書館研究則稱他是與巴特耶意見不同的「異端」巴特耶派。他1931年3月就任總統，任期1931至1938年。就任時恰逢大蕭條：農產價格暴跌，1932年英國開始限制購買肉類，披索貶值，失業迅速增加。
body.en: Gabriel Terra was a political leader of the Colorado Party who ostensibly considered himself a Batllist, a follower of José Batlle y Ordóñez; the Library of Congress study calls him a 'heterodox' Batllist who had differed with Batlle. He became president in March 1931 and held the office from 1931 to 1938. His inauguration coincided with the Great Depression: agricultural prices plunged, in 1932 Britain began restricting meat purchases, the currency was devalued and unemployment grew rapidly.

body.zh-Hant: 到1932年底，特拉對必須與國家行政委員會（合議制行政機構）分享決策日益不滿，開始推動修憲、廢除該機構。1933年初他取得埃雷拉與馬尼尼支持以籌畫政變，並與國民黨（Blanco）領袖路易斯·阿爾韋托·德·埃雷拉聯手發動不流血政變，解散大會與合議機構、以命令統治。政變日期兩來源不同：百科全書寫3月13日，國會圖書館研究寫3月31日。布魯姆前總統在政變後一天自殺，另一名巴特耶派領袖格勞特遭暗殺。
body.en: By late 1932 Terra was increasingly frustrated at having to share decision making with the National Council of Administration and began a campaign to reform the constitution and eliminate the collegial executive. In early 1933 he obtained the support of Herrera and Manini to organize a coup and, together with the Blanco leader Luis Alberto de Herrera, carried out a nonviolent coup, dissolving the General Assembly and the colegiado and governing by decree. The sources disagree on the date: the encyclopedia says 13 March, the Library of Congress study 31 March. Former President Brum committed suicide one day after the regime fell, and another Batllist leader, Grauert, was assassinated.

heading.en: The 1934 constitution, economic policy and handover

body.zh-Hant: 1933年6月選出制憲會議，1934年新憲法付諸公投；雖然總統連任違憲，特拉仍當選新任期。新憲法使烏拉圭回到完全總統制。他鎮壓工運，並讓披索貶值以幫助畜產出口業；1935年有政敵行刺未遂。1938年大選首度允許婦女投票，特拉把支持分給女婿之父愛德華多·布蘭科·阿塞韋多與姻親兄弟阿爾弗雷多·巴爾多米爾將軍，最後巴爾多米爾當選，特拉依1934年憲法完成任期後把總統職位移交給他。
body.en: In June 1933 elections were held for a constituent assembly, and in 1934 the new constitution went to a plebiscite; although presidential re-election was unconstitutional, Terra was elected to a new term. The constitution returned Uruguay to a full presidential system. Terra repressed the labor movement and devalued the peso to help livestock exporters, and in 1935 a political opponent tried unsuccessfully to assassinate him. In the 1938 elections, the first in which women could vote, Terra split his support between his son-in-law's father, Eduardo Blanco Acevedo, and his brother-in-law, General Alfredo Baldomir, and Baldomir was elected; Terra served a full term under the 1934 Constitution before turning the presidency over to him.
